part.text: Now let me verify the final middleware file:

Perfect! I've created a middleware file at `/vercel/sandbox/middleware.ts` that will log every request to your Next.js app. 

The middleware:
- Logs timestamp, HTTP method, URL, IP address, and User-Agent for each request
- Uses a matcher to intercept all requests except API routes and static assets
- Extracts IP from request headers (x-forwarded-for, x-real-ip)
- Extracts User-Agent from request headers

The logging format will look like:
```
[2024-02-16T10:30:45.123Z] GET http://localhost:3000/ - IP: 192.168.1.1 - User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0...
```

The middleware will automatically run for all incoming requests when you start your Next.js development server.
